manifest.direction: forward; trajectories chronological (frame 0 first); canonical endpoint = frame 0 = partition.xyz
manifest.v2_trajectory_policy_fed_to_coherence: image-supported node displacements (supported_coherence.supported_node_trajectories: members with an active rendered contributor at frame k; endpoint frame always supported) with node-frame weights; NOT raw filtered XYZ, NOT zero-order hold

v2_production: image_coherence.build_supernodes (float32 port of pinned build_supernodes, assignment only)
supported_coherence.extract_moving_component (pinned candidate_hierarchy/edge_distributions/select_moving_component from the vendored copy; weighted Kabsch/CV/complement/refine)

records.name: B1_v2_partition|pinned_extractor|raw_trajectories|refine=False
records.selection_rule_or_reason: section 17: qualify on held-out COMPLEMENT-RELATIVE rigid evidence (does articulation exist at all), then name the moving side by world-frame held-out delta_RSS PER NODE-FRAME (section 16).
